summary: Phase-A engine consolidation verified end-to-end. Backend: 99 passed + 1 skipped (test_feed_complete gracefully skipped — legacy feed_tasks queue empty) across 100 collected tests in 42s; all phaseA targets met. GET /api/dashboard/summary returns _source='engine' with feed_today_total=13, meds_due=2 (engine-derived from tasks collection). GET /api/dashboard/barn-board returns _deprecated='Use /tasks/today; this endpoint will be removed.' with feed[]/medications[] hydrated from tasks collection (task-shaped docs including template_id/payload/window_start/window_end — confirming engine backing, not legacy). barn-board feed count (13) matches summary feed_today_total — consistency verified. /app/backend/storage.py imports cleanly; get_provider() returns LocalDevStorage stub when STORAGE_PROVIDER env is unset. Frontend: Sidebar shows Today but NO 'Barn Board' entry; /barn-board redirects to /today (final URL /today); Today renders with no horizontal scroll at 420/1024/1440 (scrollWidth===clientWidth at all three breakpoints); max-w-4xl confirmed on line 422 of Today.jsx. Dashboard 'Open Today' link href=/today, clicks navigate correctly. Mobile FAB at fixed bottom-right navigates to /today. BarnBoard.jsx file deleted (no lingering imports). Notifications bell still works (data-testid=notifications-btn, panel opens). Regression sweep clean across /today, /feed, /medications, /health, /owner-portal, /horses, /settings — zero error elements rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:520-579 /dashboard/summary correctly engine-derived with _source='engine' tag and consistent today-window (UTC midnight) computed once and reused. Good.

server.py:582-613 /dashboard/barn-board preserves shape for legacy callers while flipping data source to tasks collection. _deprecated key is informational only — callers will not break. Consider adding `Deprecation` and `Sunset` HTTP headers (RFC 8594) so HTTP-level clients also see deprecation signal, not just JSON body.

storage.py:193-214 get_provider() caches via module-level _provider. If STORAGE_PROVIDER env is set after first call, change won't take effect until process restart. Acceptable for prod, but flag for tests that may want to reset (expose _provider=None helper).

storage.py LocalDevStorage.prepare_upload returns a stub URL `/api/uploads/_stub_/{id}` but no actual upload route mounts that path — by design (scaffold-only). When upload routes land, ensure they 501/404 explicitly on the stub path so clients fail loudly instead of silently writing into the void.

Dashboard.jsx:35 still calls /dashboard/barn-board even though Barn Board page is retired. This is acceptable since the endpoint is engine-backed now and Dashboard uses subset of its data, but consider migrating Dashboard to call /tasks/today directly in next phase to fully retire the legacy endpoint.
Onboarding.jsx:277 description still references 'daily Barn Board' — minor copy nit. Update to 'daily Today view' for consistency with retired terminology.

test_equinesync.py test_feed_complete is skipped because legacy feed_tasks queue is empty post-migration. Once legacy feed_tasks collection is fully removed, this test should be deleted (not perpetually skipped) to keep the suite honest.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 Phase-A UI checks + 7-route regression sweep passed)

seed_data_creation: None new; relied on existing seeded tenant. Pytest suite creates and cleans TEST_* prefixed records as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When running pytest, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported in shell env (not just frontend/.env) — both test_invites_and_analytics.py and test_onboarding.py read os.environ at import time and AttributeError on collection if unset. Workaround: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && pytest …`. Storage module is scaffold-only — no upload routes mounted yet. /dashboard/barn-board still exists (returns task-shaped data + _deprecated stamp); Dashboard.jsx still consumes it. Today page uses max-w-4xl (line 422). Mobile FAB on Dashboard is a fixed-position button at bottom-right; locate via getComputedStyle position==='fixed' rather than testid.
rca of the issue: N/A — Phase-A acceptance test, no regressions found.
